issue.title: Security and bug audit fixes
issue.description: The 19 verified findings from the five-area security/bug audit of bob-cli are fixed with regression tests: git pathspec globbing can no longer revert the wrong vault file, calendar titles can no longer inject tags/links, the web clipper's private- network guard holds across redirects and WebSockets, vault writes are guarded and crash-durable, and the small verified defects are corrected.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/security_audit_fixes_1.md requests this work

issue.title: Literal git pathspecs for vault filenames
issue.description: git-literal-pathspecs: switch the highlights_ref recovery/mutation and collect_done git call sites that pass concrete vault filenames from ob::git_command to ob::git_command_literal, reject pathspec magic in recovery's validated_paths, and add glob-filename regression tests.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/security_audit_fixes_1.md defines phase git-literal-pathspecs as one work unit

issue.title: Gcal remote-text trust boundary
issue.description: gcal-title-hardening: extend gcal escape_title to neutralize mid-line tags, wikilinks, and Markdown links in organizer-authored event titles; fix the gog 429 substring misclassification; optionally gate #on/#off clock tags on organizer_is_self per the memory decision.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/security_audit_fixes_1.md defines phase gcal-title-hardening as one work unit

issue.title: Web-clip network guards and image handling
issue.description: web-clip-guards: re-validate the final navigation URL and redirect chain against host_is_global, block unguarded WebSocket handshakes, parse img attributes positionally so data-bob-origin query strings cannot drop images, and make the origin re.sub replacement literal.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/security_audit_fixes_1.md defines phase web-clip-guards as one work unit

issue.title: Durable and race-free vault writes
issue.description: durable-vault-writes: bind bank ensure's write-guard preimage to its single planning snapshot, install clip attachments via hard_link/create_new, fsync the three non-flushing atomic_write variants and the gkeep token write, and verify ownership of the shared-tmp script-cache fallback.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/security_audit_fixes_1.md defines phase durable-vault-writes as one work unit

issue.title: Small verified fixes
issue.description: small-audit-fixes: prefix-match the pomodoro OVERDUE status, close the perl two-arg open in bob_pomodoro, report damaged albums as io instead of note_changed, require FILE args on bank import, and strip migration anchors by match span.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/security_audit_fixes_1.md defines phase small-audit-fixes as one work unit

payload.description: derived from the plan's `bead_id:` frontmatter field

payload.entry: Implemented all four web-clip-guards fixes in scripts/web_clip/: (A) post-goto re-validation of final URL + redirect chain via _private_landing_url in headless and headed paths, skipped for fixture hooks/--html; (B) per-context route_web_socket guard allowing only ws/wss to global hosts; (C) positional img src parse/rewrite (_img_attr/_set_img_src) in adapter _localize_images and render normalize_images/prefix_part_assets; (D) lambda re.sub for data-bob-origin insertion. Verified: just check-web-clip-adapter gate green (py_compile + self-test exit 0, 'ok'), new regression checks all pass, old-code failures reproduced in scratch probe, teardown noise confirmed pre-existing on base tree, no epic-symbol leftovers.

Verified: escape_title now neutralizing mid-line #tags, [[wikilinks]], and Markdown ]( links after clock tokens are stripped; classify_gog_failure matches 429 only as an HTTP status token so team-429@ identifiers are not retried; journal title hashes follow the escaped span so untouched Google updates rewrite once. gate_organizer_clock_tags=no so no clock-tag or memory edits. just check staged for host completion and close.

Verified prefix OVERDUE match (Rust notify + bob_notify), perl 3-arg open in bob_pomodoro, damaged albums as io not note_changed, required FILE on bank import with empty-list refusal, and tracker complete_line strip by BLOCK_ID match span. Focused tests passed; just check staged for host close.
